verdicts.reason: Both use the same leaderboard layout, and both have the same problems. The subtitle is squeezed into a narrow six-line column with tiny, nearly illegible text and orphaned words ('golden / hour.'). The translucent circle collides with 'Light' and with the subtitle. The can is shrunk to a speck with an unreadable label, and the NEW FLAVOR pill is about as prominent as the CTA. B is also worse on brand: its SOLSTICE logo is clipped, with the sun icon and wordmark cut off at the top, while A's logo is intact.
